title: Demo name flows into file paths unsanitized (path traversal)
detail: The demo name (CLI args or demos/ dir listing) is interpolated raw into demos/, goldens/, and report paths with no '/' or '..' check; a traversal name escapes the goldens tree on read and on write (harness save / mkdir_p).
recommended_fix: Validate the demo name once at run_demo entry against ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ (reject '/' and '..'), before any path interpolation. A single guard covers all six path-construction sites.
